name: c-stepper-39
title: Stepper with vertical step cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as stacked icon cards beside the step detail, done cards tinted green with a corner check, plus Previous and Next.

"use client" import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react" import { Frame, FramePanel } from "@/components/reui/frame" import { IconTile } from "@/components/reui/icon-tile" import { Stepper, StepperContent, StepperDescription, StepperIndicator, StepperItem, StepperNav, StepperPanel, StepperTitle, StepperTrigger, } from "@/components/reui/stepper" import { cn } from "cn" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const steps = [ { title: "Resolution", detail: "Choose between a rollback, a scale-out or a hotfix.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Execute", detail: "Roll api-gateway back to v2.14.1 across 6 pods.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Verify", detail: "Watch error rate and p95 latency for 10 minutes.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Summary", detail: "Write up the timeline, root cause and follow-ups.", icon: ( ), }, ] const completed = ( ) export function Pattern() { // The primitive derives tab ids from the step number alone and points // aria-controls at a panel nothing renders, so both are scoped here. const id = useId() const panelId = `${id}-panel` const [current, setCurrent] = useState(2) const prevRef = useRef(null) const nextRef = useRef(null) // One past the last step marks every step complete. No tab is selected // then, so the last one keeps the tablist's tab stop. const allDone = current > steps.length function goTo(step: number) { setCurrent(step) // The pressed button disables itself at either end, so focus moves to // its partner. if (step === 1) nextRef.current?.focus() if (step > steps.length) prevRef.current?.focus() } return ( {/* The cards keep their 240px beside the content. Under 28rem the content would get less than 176px, so it stacks below. */}
{/* The frame paints nothing and only lends each card its per-style radius, padding, border and surface. The default variant, not ghost, so vega and nova cards round at the drawn 10px, not 11px. */} {steps.map((item, index) => { const step = index + 1 const done = step < current return ( {/* The card is the tab itself, so all of it takes the click and the focus ring. The radius undoes the trigger's pill. The done tint is a 5% layer over the opaque card color, stacked as drawn, so nothing behind the card shows through. The design draws no card shadow and no current-step state, so border-ring marks the selected card. */} } className="hover:border-ring/60 data-[state=active]:border-ring/50 data-[state=active]:bg-input/20 data-[state=completed]:border-success data-[state=completed]:from-success/5 data-[state=completed]:to-success/5 w-full gap-2 rounded-(--frame-panel-radius) px-2.5 shadow-none data-[state=completed]:bg-linear-to-b" > {/* 28px sits between the xs and sm rungs, so xs keeps its 14px glyph and the size is set directly. outline's dark:bg-input/32 would outrank a state class in dark mode, so a done step swaps to the solid variant. */} {item.icon} {/* leading-5 is text-sm's own line height. Under truncate the default leading-none clips the y of Verify and Summary. */}
{item.title} Step {step} {done && , completed}
{/* Sits on the item, clear of the panel's overflow clip, and lets clicks through. Its center lands 0.4r in and 0.1r down from the corner, just above the arc (0.2r down there): 3px out and 6px up at the drawn 10px, on the corner when square. max() floors the square styles' radius, which the frame's math takes below 0. z-10 clears a focused card, the item's isolate keeps it off the host page, and the stepper's pt-2 makes room for the first check. */} ) })} {/* Decorative, so hidden from assistive tech: a line across while the columns stack, a line between them once they sit side by side. */}
